description: Machine-readable status of a generation that returned "pending". Returns status (queued, running, done, failed, not_found), progress (0 to 1, null when unknown), eta_seconds, and next_check_seconds while it runs; the asset links (viewer_url, glb_url, poster_png_url, embed_html) when done; and a plain error with a remedy when it failed. Safe to call on a schedule: it never starts work and is not counted against the generation quota. Use this to poll a pending job from code or a loop; call check_job with the same job_id when you want the finished model rendered in the inline viewer.

job_id.description: The job_id (or jobId) a pending generation returned.

refine.description: Optional: the refine object a pending refine_model result carried, passed back unchanged.

name: get_job
title: Get the status of a 3D job
